facts.statement: The genus Oxyosteus was first described by Jaekel in 1911.
Fossils of Oxyosteus date from the Middle to Late Frasnian periods.
Oxyosteus was a trout-sized, highly compressed arthrodire placoderm found in Late Devonian Europe.
facts.quote: Oxyosteus is a genus of trout-sized, highly compressed arthrodire placoderms from the Late Devonian of Europe

facts.statement: Living Oxyosteus animals would have looked superficially like modern needlefish or houndfish.
facts.quote: The living animals would have superficially resembled modern-day needlefish or houndfish

facts.statement: Oxyosteus is distinguished by very thin plates and a dermal surface covered in small, closely packed tubercles.
facts.quote: The genus is distinguished from other members of the family in that the plates are very thin, and the dermal surface is typically covered in small, closely packed tubercles

facts.statement: Oxyosteus was originally in its own family but was later merged into the family Brachydeiridae.
facts.quote: The genus was originally placed in its own family, but was then later determined to be closely related to Brachydeirus and Synauchenia, and was then merged into the family Brachydeiridae

facts.statement: Oxyosteus species had an extremely compressed body, a pointed elongated snout, and very large eyes.
facts.quote: Species have, in cross section, an extremely compressed body, a pointed, highly elongated snout, and tremendous orbits

facts.statement: The skull length of Oxyosteus rostratus ranges from 11 to 13 cm.
facts.quote: Skull lengths range from 11 to 13 cm

facts.statement: The holotype skull of Oxyosteus magnus is 18 cm long.
facts.quote: the skull length of the holotype is 18 cm long

facts.statement: An unnamed Oxyosteus species was found in Middle Frasnian strata in the Holy Cross Mountains of Poland.
facts.quote: The plate was found in the Middle Frasnian portion of the Late Devonian strata of the Holy Cross Mountains in Poland

facts.statement: The parent group of Oxyosteus is Titanichthyidae.
Oxyosteus belongs to the class Placodermi.
Oxyosteus lived between 382.31 and 372.15 million years ago during the Frasnian.
facts.quote: Time range: Frasnian to Frasnian (382.31 to 372.15 million years ago)
